metadata.title: Around Atzomx | Walkable spots in Oaxaca Centro
metadata.description: A walking guide to 10 places near Atzomx Coworking: culture, coffee, local food, and a garden in Oaxaca’s historic center.

banner.title: Around Atzomx
banner.subtitle: Ten walking stops from the coworking space: culture, coffee, and local food to break up the workday.

zocalo.name: Zócalo de Oaxaca
zocalo.description: The heart of the historic center. Walk the arcades, grab a drink, and start exploring the city.

andador-turistico.name: Andador Turístico
andador-turistico.description: One of the best walks from Atzomx. It links Centro streets with galleries, shops, restaurants, and historic buildings.

centro-cultural-san-pablo.name: Centro Cultural San Pablo
centro-cultural-san-pablo.description: A former convent turned cultural space. A short pause around the corner from Atzomx.

museo-textil.name: Museo Textil de Oaxaca
museo-textil.description: A museum of textile art from Oaxaca and Mexico. A 30–60 minute visit before you sit back down.

jardin-etnobiologico.name: Jardín Etnobiológico de Oaxaca
jardin-etnobiologico.description: A garden in the old Santo Domingo convent, with plants native to Oaxaca. A reset after hours at the laptop.

casa-juarez.name: Museo de Sitio Casa Juárez
casa-juarez.description: The house where Benito Juárez lived as a young man, now a small museum. Fits a walk through Centro.

cafe-rustiko.name: Café Rústiko
cafe-rustiko.description: Another Centro café for the ritual after Atzomx, or a pause on the walk.

boulenc.name: Boulenc
boulenc.description: A bakery and restaurant popular with locals and visitors. Breakfast, lunch, or a change of table mid-day.

casa-oaxaca.name: Casa Oaxaca
casa-oaxaca.description: Oaxacan cooking to close the day after work or a walk through Centro.

mercado-benito-juarez.name: Mercado Benito Juárez
mercado-benito-juarez.description: Step away from the laptop and eat at the market: stalls, flavors, and the daily rhythm of Centro.

routine.title: A day in a nomad’s routine
routine.subtitle: Four beats in Centro: coffee in-house, focus, lunch on the terrace, and a cultural walk to close.

coffee.title: Specialty coffee
coffee.description: Start at the Atzomx bar. No need to leave the building.

focus.title: Focus at Atzomx
focus.description: 1000 Mbps fiber, a desk, and specialty coffee for the long session.

lunch.title: Lunch on the terrace
lunch.description: Eat upstairs with a view. The desk stays below; the neighborhood is in sight.

walk.title: Andador, San Pablo, textiles
walk.description: Close with the pedestrian street, the convent around the corner, or the Textile Museum three minutes away.

gallery.title: A base in Centro, the neighborhood at the door

cta.title: Make this neighborhood your office
cta.description: Book a day or a month. Centro is minutes away; the desk is here.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hi! I’d like to book coworking at Atzomx — I’m interested in Centro and the area around you.
